items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of tree-felling permit
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Musterbek, Musterbeker Markt 4, 22297 Hamburg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 30.04.2026 (no separate zur Post gegeben date, so posting day = document date). Bezirksamt is a general authority, not a tax office, so the 4-day delivery fiction applies without weekend/holiday shift: 4th day after 30.04.2026 = 04.05.2026 (Mon) - counting Fri 1 May, Sat 2 May, Sun 3 May, Mon 4 May; 4 May is not a holiday in HH anyway. Deemed delivery = 04.05.2026. One-month Widerspruch period per section 187(1)/188(2) BGB: delivery day not counted, period ends on the day in the following month with the same number, i.e. 04.06.2026. That day (Thursday) is a normal working day in Hamburg (Corpus Christi falls on that date but is not a holiday in HH), so no further shift is needed. Deadline = 04.06.2026.
